text: Update on the leftovers. (1) Odds API keys: I traced it and found no hidden usage check and no key being used alongside another. Every Odds API call goes through one pool that picks the first key with credits. The big numbers are explained: key e4d5 shows 1,386 calls but only 76 credits because the game-list calls cost nothing. Keys 10-14 show about 15 calls each because they were each tried once when the key before them ran out. Your 21 keys are all loaded. The v1.0.2 sticky-key change is already in, so there is nothing to ship for this one. (2) Nothing else is built yet, so no new release has gone out. I haven't done SX soccer totals, the Pinnacle-first change for the Odds API, the 12-second manual-bet errors, or the Kalshi arbitrage research. Those are queued in order (CH9, CH13, CH12, CH11) and each goes in the next release as it lands. If one matters most to you, tell me which.
